source_pr_title: feat(gha-runner): resolve app installation ID; add libssl
author: amazon-q-developer
body:
:stop_sign: **Logic Error**: Missing error handling for INSTALLATION_TOKEN. If the API call fails, the token will be empty causing the subsequent registration token request to fail silently with authentication errors.
```suggestion
# Get installation token
INSTALLATION_TOKEN=$(curl -sf -X POST \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $JWT" \\
  -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \\
  "" | jq -r '.token')
[ -n "$INSTALLATION_TOKEN" ] || { echo "ERROR: Failed to get installation token" >&2; exit 1; }
```

source_pr_title: feat(gha-runner): resolve app installation ID; add libssl
author: amazon-q-developer
body:
:stop_sign: **Logic Error**: Missing error handling for REGISTRATION_TOKEN. If the API call fails, the token will be empty causing config.sh to fail with unclear errors during runner registration.
```suggestion
# Get registration token
REGISTRATION_TOKEN=$(curl -sf -X POST \\
  -H "Authorization: token $INSTALLATION_TOKEN" \\
  -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \\
  "" | jq -r '.token')
[ -n "$REGISTRATION_TOKEN" ] || { echo "ERROR: Failed to get registration token" >&2; exit 1; }
```
